recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the published FHIR-34041 change on both current build-scope checklist surfaces without adding stronger narrative rules or broadening into unrelated narrative-scope issues.
issue_request: FHIR-34041 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked FHIR-core narrative clinical-safety guidance to discuss whether narrative should be present as a fallback for receivers that do not recognize all data, the safety/readability considerations when generating narrative, and when consumers should make narrative available based on Narrative.status.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged source commit c334df8913e061457af9bf5dfab60da075e36fa9 added a Narrative / Presentation Related Safety Checks section to source/safety.html with items for sending, generating, and showing narratives, plus the Narrative.status paragraph. The current source still had that page text, but the page advertises the checklist as the safety-entries CodeSystem and that active CodeSystem still contained only render-narratives; the three FHIR-34041 items also reused the render-narratives anchor.
additional_context: The originating Zulip conformance thread shows why the work group chose checklist guidance: ignoring narrative depends on context and Narrative.status, and generating generic human-readable clinical narrative safely is difficult. FHIR-I WGM minutes page 101355607 records the final Persuasive with Modification motion. source/hierarchy.xml lists safety.html as a current page, and source/fhir.ini actively includes codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml as the safety-entries CodeSystem.
reconciliation: Updated source/safety.html so the FHIR-34041 checklist items have their own local anchors, adjusted the sending-narratives text to match the approved safe-fallback intent, and removed a stale numbered reference in the Narrative.status paragraph. Added matching sending-narratives, generating-narratives, and showing-narratives concepts to source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml.
source_changes: source/safety.html: corrected the FHIR-34041 narrative checklist item anchors, aligned the sending-narratives wording with the approved safe-fallback request, and replaced the stale numeric Narrative.status reference.
source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml: added sending-narratives, generating-narratives, and showing-narratives concepts to the active formal checklist CodeSystem.
